findings.title: Cancel/get task lacks ownership scoping
findings.problem: on_cancel_task (and on_get_task) load Task.find_by_id(id) with no check that the task belongs to the assistant in the URL or the calling user. Any user with READ access to any assistant can cancel or read another task by id. Cancel also only flips stored status; the running invocation is not interrupted.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant task cancellation/read by guessing or obtaining task ids; canceled tasks continue consuming resources.
findings.recommendation: Verify task ownership (assistant/user) before returning or cancelling; return TaskNotFoundError otherwise. Optionally signal the running invocation to stop.

findings.title: Streaming path skips validation and re-runs terminal tasks
findings.problem: on_send_streaming_message uses Task.find_by_id(...) or upsert_task(...) and never calls _validate_request; unlike SendMessage, an existing task's new message is not appended to history, and a COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELED task is silently re-run.
findings.impact: Incompatible acceptedOutputModes accepted; canceled tasks revived and overwritten; history diverges from the non-streaming path.
findings.recommendation: Call _validate_request first (yield its error and return) and use upsert_task consistently; reject or explicitly handle terminal-state tasks.

findings.title: Cancel is overwritten by completion
findings.problem: _invoke_agent and _handle_a2a_stream call update_store with COMPLETED/FAILED/INPUT_REQUIRED after the agent returns without re-reading the stored state; a CancelTask that set CANCELED during the invocation is silently overwritten (check-then-act, no atomicity).
findings.impact: Canceled task reported as completed; real cancel is not durable.
findings.recommendation: Re-read the task before the final update_store and skip the write (emit CANCELED final) if state is CANCELED.

findings.title: Streaming emits status-only frames, no output
findings.problem: _create_streaming_response builds TaskStatusUpdateEvent(status=TaskStatus(state=state)) only: the agent message, error text and artifact are dropped, no TaskArtifactUpdateEvent is ever yielded, and events carry no contextId. Tests assert only status.state. final=True is also set for INPUT_REQUIRED. Spec AC requires status/artifact event frames ending in terminal state.
findings.impact: SSE clients receive working then completed with no answer content; 'real streaming' delivers no result. Required AC is partial.
findings.recommendation: Include the task status message in the final status event and yield a TaskArtifactUpdateEvent for the artifact; add contextId to events; assert content in tests.

findings.title: GetExtendedAgentCard params wrongly typed
findings.problem: GetExtendedAgentCardRequest.params is TaskIdParams | None, whose required 'id' means a spec-conformant empty params object {} fails validation.
findings.impact: Spec-conformant clients get InvalidRequest (-32600) for GetExtendedAgentCard.
findings.recommendation: Use params: dict[str, Any] | None = None (or a dedicated empty params model).

findings.title: Out-of-scope methods return -32600, not -32601
findings.problem: Known Task 10 gap: A2ARequest covers only the 5 in-scope methods, so ListTasks/SubscribeToTask/push-config fail validation and return 400/-32600 instead of the AC's MethodNotFound (-32601); the MethodNotFoundError dispatch branch is now dead code, SendStreamingMessage is handled ahead of the table, and the router test pins 400/-32600.
findings.impact: Spec AC for unmapped methods is unmet; dead fallback code remains.
findings.recommendation: User decides: pre-check the method name and return -32601, add stub request classes to the union, or amend the AC to accept -32600 and remove the dead branch.

findings.title: Router tests miss success paths
findings.problem: GetTask and CancelTask are only exercised with an unknown id (test_cancel_task_success asserts the not-found path); no router-level successful GetTask/CancelTask and no SSE error-frame test.
findings.impact: Success dispatch of two required methods is unverified at router level.
findings.recommendation: Add successful GetTask and CancelTask router tests and rename the misnamed test.
